description: Failed IMDS credential requests are now retried with capped exponential backoff, except a token request rejected with 400 or 403 and a metadata request answered with 403 or 404. `IMDSConfig.retry_strategy` is replaced by `max_attempts`, which defaults to 4 (3 retries) and can also be set with `AWS_METADATA_SERVICE_NUM_ATTEMPTS` or the `metadata_service_num_attempts` config setting. IMDS requests now time out after 1 second, except the connect timeout of an HTTP client you provide to the synchronous client, which is left as configured. Session tokens now expire after the TTL IMDS returns, which can differ from the one requested. The `send` callable given to `fetch_token` and `fetch_metadata` now also receives an `HTTPRequestConfiguration`, and `fetch_token` returns an `IMDSToken` instead of a `str`. `aws_credentials_imds.client` and `aws_credentials_imds.aio.client` no longer re-export `fetch_metadata`; use `get_metadata`, which adds the retries.
